reason: Not paying until I'm happy is better than anything the last designer offered, I'll give him that. But one lad in Kuwait with no UK clients and a made-up plumber demo? I've been burned once and I'm not going through it again with someone I can't drive round to see.
objection: When the site goes down on a Saturday or I need something changed, will he actually answer from Kuwait, or will I be stuck chasing him on WhatsApp for weeks like last time while paying £43 a month?
would_change_my_mind: Talking on the phone to a real UK business owner he's already built for, who tells me he finished on time and still answers when something breaks.
